crossRefs.note: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in…
He who kills an ox is as he who kills a man; he who sacrifices a lamb, as he who breaks a dog’s neck; he who offers an…
I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them; because when I called, no one answered; when I…
And in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’ ”
But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.
They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service…
“I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Micah
people.line: A man from Ephraim who set up idolatrous worship.

translations.web: Then Micah said, “Now I know that Yahweh will do good to me, since I have a Levite as my priest.”
translations.bsb: Then Micah said, “Now I know that the LORD will be good to me, because a Levite has become my priest.”
translations.kjv: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.
translations.asv: Then said Micah, Now know I that Jehovah will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.
